svg.text: vLLM — how the system fits together
The V1 architecture: several processes, one busy loop, a paged KV cache, and one captured graph per batch shape. Read the bands top to bottom — that is the path one request takes.
1 · HOW YOU RUN IT · one library, two entrypoints, and a lot of protocols on top
2 · THE V1 PROCESS ARCHITECTURE · count the processes before you size the box, because they are not all on the GPU
3 · THE ENGINE CORE LOOP · one busy loop that never waits for any single request
4 · THE PAGED KV CACHE · the original idea, and still the thing that decides how many requests fit
5 · THE WORKER AND THE FORWARD PASS · one process per GPU, one model runner, one captured graph per shape
6 · SAMPLING AND STRUCTURED OUTPUT · everything between the logits and the token you actually return
7 · SCALING OUT · four kinds of parallelism, and a KV cache that can leave the GPU
8 · RUNNING IT FOR REAL · the parts that only show up once there is traffic
R · ONE REQUEST, END TO END · the path through the bands
